segments.he:
א.

הַמִּתְבָּרֵךְ צָרִיךְ לִתֵּן לַמְבָרֵךְ אֵיזֶה מַתָּנָה.
segments.en: The one who is blessed should give the one who blessed him a gift.

segments.he:
ב.

אַל תְּהִי בִּרְכַּת גּוֹי קַלָּה בְּעֵינֶיךָ.
segments.en: The one who is blessed should give the one who blessed him a gift.

segments.he:
ג.

מִי שֶׁמְּקָרֵב אֶת הָרְחוֹקִים לַעֲבוֹדַת הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ הַבְּרָכוֹת מְסוּרִים בְּיָדוֹ.
segments.en:
The blessing of a non-Jew should not be insignificant in your eyes.

One who brings those who are far, close to the service of the Blessed L-rd, the blessings are given over to his hands. is empowered to grant blessings.
